description: Implementation of the DnsConfigService class managing DNS configuration and hosts reading, watching, and invalidation logic within the net namespace.

classes.name: DnsConfigService
classes.description: Manages DNS configuration and hosts reading, watching, and invalidation.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::Watcher
classes.description: Handles configuration and hosts change notifications.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader
classes.description: Reads and processes DNS hosts from a file.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader::WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for reading DNS hosts.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::DnsConfigService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with hosts file path and optional config change delay.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnConfigRead
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS config read.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnHostsRead
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS hosts read.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer for config invalidation.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles timer expiration to invalidate config.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnCompleteConfig
methods.description: Finalizes and reports the current DNS config.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles external config change notifications with optional delay.
